# Slagelse Pædiatri

Slagelse Pædiatri is a pediatric department participating in the DANIBD registry, Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The department is monitored for compliance with indicator 1b, which measures complete diagnostic workup of newly diagnosed IBD in children and young people. Complete workup is defined as gastroscopy, colonoscopy, and MR scanning or capsule endoscopy[^src1].

As of the 2024 audit cycle, Slagelse Pædiatri achieved 33% compliance with indicator 1b[^src1]. This places the department below the national target of 69% compliance, which itself fell short of the developmental goal across Danish hospitals and regions[^src1]. The low compliance reflects broader variation in diagnostic practices across Danish pediatric units treating IBD patients.

Slagelse Pædiatri is one of several departments evaluated in the DANIBD registry framework, which encompasses patients with IBD treated at public Danish hospitals and has a documented coverage rate exceeding 90%[^src1]. The 2024 audit included examination of both regional and departmental-level variation in indicator 1b compliance, with plans for re-evaluation at the next audit in 2026[^src1].
